{{Quote|Good day, lieutenant. Welcome aboard the Justice.|Lieutenant Romm|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Romm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad's new commander]] infiltrated the [[Justice (Harrower-class)|''Justice'']] to stop [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harron Tavus|Tavus]], Romm was tasked with greeting new arrivals to the ''Justice''.
